light.best.quote: they do best with bright indirect sunlight

light.min.quote: they will grow in very low levels of light

light.directSun.quote: Scalding and browning of leaves can occur if the plant is placed in direct sunlight.

temperature.minC.quote: ZZ plants are sensitive to cold and should be kept above 60 °F.

temperature.idealC.reason: 出典に数値の記載がないため、熱帯原産の観葉植物が成長する一般的な室温の範囲とした

humidity.quote: ZZ plants are acclimated to arid conditions and will thrive with regular indoor humidity levels.

watering.growing.quote: Water twice monthly in the summer, but only if the soil has dried out completely.

watering.winter.quote: Water it only once a month in winter months when it is not actively growing.

tips.ja: 肥料は年に1〜2回、観葉植物用の液体肥料で十分。
tips.quote: Use a balanced liquid houseplant fertilizer once or twice a year.

note: 「ザミア」は別の植物（ソテツの仲間 Zamia）の名前でもあるので注意。
